Human oversight.control_description: Human approval gates are surfaced before consequential email-security and threat-hunt actions.

Outcome monitoring.control_description: Decision traces and evidence contracts are retained for post-hoc review and monitoring.

Risk treatment.control_description: Evidence-backed route decisions and downgraded heuristic handling reduce overclaim and route risky cases to review.

Model governance.control_description: Model/provider selection is registry-backed, but governance evidence is not yet full audit-grade.

Prompt handling.control_description: Prompt-like OCR and payload content is sanitized and policy-gated before model-facing handling.

Article 9.control_description: Risk treatment is partially implemented through evidence-quality gating, but a full AI risk-management system is not yet evidenced.

Article 14.control_description: Human oversight is enforced in the demo workflow before consequential security actions.

Article 15.control_description: Robustness controls are partially implemented through OCR-confidence downgrades and evidence-quality banners.

Article 5.control_description: Integrity and minimisation controls exist in parts of the privacy pipeline, but they are not universally benchmarked.

Article 32.control_description: Technical security measures exist, but artifact-driven GDPR relevance should still be treated as possible unless a breach is evidenced.

Article 33.control_description: Breach-notification handling is not auto-confirmed from heuristic exfiltration indicators and remains analyst-driven.
